نكتفي (form VIII)
# نَكْتَفِي (naktafī) /nak.ta.fiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِكْتَفَى (iktafā)
# نَكْتَفِيَ (naktafiya) /nak.ta.fi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِكْتَفَى (iktafā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
